findings.description: The KMS key used for the audit trail bucket does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so the key material is never rotated automatically. Long-lived key material increases the impact window if the key is ever compromised and weakens cryptographic hygiene for audit log encryption.

No policy attribute is specified, so the key falls back to the default KMS key policy which delegates full access control to IAM in the account root. Without an explicit least-privilege key policy, any principal granted broad IAM kms:* permissions can decrypt audit trail data, and there is no key-level guardrail restricting use or scheduling deletion.
